summary: Undisclosed auto-follow of author-controlled WhatsApp channels using the installer's session
details: This is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library that adds an undisclosed side-effect to the socket setup. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js, makeNewsletterSocket (invoked transitively by the exported makeWASocket) schedules a setTimeout ~120 seconds after socket creation that fetches a JSON list of newsletter JIDs from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DGXeon13/strings/refs/heads/main/strings.json and issues authenticated QueryIds.FOLLOW newsletter-follow queries for each JID using the consumer's WhatsApp session. The URL is on a mutable branch controlled by the package author, so the target list can be rotated post-install. The README describes a generic Baileys/WhatsApp library and does not mention this behavior; a sibling newsletter.js.bak preserves the upstream file without the injected block. The action uses the installer's authenticated identity to perform account actions the caller did not request, but does not exfiltrate credentials, read installer secrets, execute remote code, or establish persistence.
